steps: Strict-parse and SHA-pin M41, M72, M78, M80, and M81 artifacts.
Recompute all 221,184 output-block widths directly from four M41 INT8 payloads and all M72 centers.
Rebuild all 1,728 word-packed and entry-aligned phase payloads in pattern-major, output-block-major order.
Recompute every packed and aligned start-word offset and test the concrete descriptor bit allocation.
Enumerate every logical bank/row request for all 835,382 packed PWP service beats and reconstruct barrel logical order.
Recompute 460/464/512-row capacity envelopes, addressable catalog bytes, and five-sample traffic.

packed_layout_result.assessment: The primary WORD_PACKED_8X32_INTERLEAVED layout is internally addressable and all logical reads fit 460 rows per bank.

aligned_descriptor_counterexample.root_cause: The producer asserts start_word<4096 only for packed_bytes and publishes one packed maximum, while the aligned variant advances its start offset by 32-byte padded entries.
aligned_descriptor_counterexample.zero_capacity_cost_fix: Replace reserved[12] with start_word[12], yielding escape[15], width_class[14:13], start_word[12:0] in the existing 16-bit descriptor.
aligned_descriptor_counterexample.verdict: P0 for the aligned variant's concrete addressability claim; packed variant unaffected.

single_pwp_bank_mapping_audit.single_cycle_answer: Yes only when the implementation is eight independently addressed 32-bit banks. In every beat each bank is requested at most once and receives either base-row or base+1. A monolithic 256-bit macro with one shared row address cannot implement 75.83 percent cross-row beats in one cycle.
single_pwp_bank_mapping_audit.barrel_cost_boundary: The arithmetic proof establishes conflict freedom, not the timing, area, energy, or zero-bubble behavior of eight row-carry selectors plus a cyclic eight-word barrel reorder.

descriptor_and_catalog_capacity.why_not_reloaded: The local descriptor is derived during prefetch from the charged 48-byte width header and sequential payload position.
descriptor_and_catalog_capacity.assessment: Packed catalog/header/offset/padding and double-buffered descriptor byte arithmetic is correct. Parser storage, control, FIFO, ECC, and macro padding remain outside this count.

m80_to_m81_capacity_comparison.interpretation: M81 correctly removes M80's impossible independent width-class maxima: the envelope moves from 72.61 percent larger than fixed12 to 18.75 percent smaller at exact depth. The realizable headline must follow the selected macro depth, where savings fall to 18.06 percent at 464 rows or 9.72 percent at 512 rows.

zero_bubble_attack.descriptor_lookup_rate: one lookup per cycle versus at least three payload beats per PWP
missing_state: final-beat valid-word mask and next-PWP transition
double-buffer swap and DMA/parser boundary assertions
zero_bubble_attack.assessment: One descriptor per cycle is sufficient as a rate bound, but it is not a causal zero-bubble proof. Cross-row selection occurs on 75.83 percent of beats and therefore cannot be treated as a rare slow path.

accepted: Exact independently reconstructed packed phase payloads, headers, offsets, alignment, descriptors, catalog, and traffic
Conflict-free one-PWP mapping across eight independently addressed 32-bit banks
Packed start_word maximum 3648 and full read coverage within exact 460-row depth
M81 exact/464/512 staging envelopes and the reversal from M80 -72.61 percent to M81 +18.75/+18.06/+9.72 percent
A local fix for the aligned descriptor overflow with no descriptor-byte growth
not_admitted: the published aligned variant under its current 12-bit start_word contract
one-cycle access through a monolithic shared-row 256-bit SRAM
barrel/address-select STA, area, power, or energy
new accelerator cycle speedup beyond the inherited M78 service model
full-network/system performance, accuracy, DATE, or best-paper headline

p0.finding: ENTRY_ALIGNED_32B has eight eligible entries with start_word 4096 through 4152, but the published descriptor allocates only start_word[11:0].
p0.impact: The aligned variant cannot address all reported phase payloads and is not a valid concrete layout under the published format.
p0.minimal_fix: Consume reserved[12] as start_word[12], rerun all descriptor assertions for both variants, and update the architecture maximum to be variant-specific.

p1.finding: Zero conflicts means one address per bank, not one common row address. 633,452 of 835,382 beats require some banks at base row and others at base+1.
p1.impact: A monolithic 256-bit macro or eight banks driven by a shared row register cannot deliver those beats in one cycle.
p1.minimal_fix: Instantiate eight independently addressed 32-bit banks and assert each frozen request maps to at most one read per bank per cycle.

p1.finding: The DSE assigns no latency, mux area, switching energy, or timing cost to eight base/base+1 selectors, word-valid masking, and the cyclic barrel reorder.
p1.impact: The shared32 critical path and energy may move from SRAM service into address/reorder logic; cross-row work is 75.83 percent of all beats.
p1.minimal_fix: Pipeline and synthesize the selector/barrel network with workload SAIF, then include its latency and energy in M78/M81 cycle and PTPX ledgers.

p1.finding: One descriptor lookup per cycle is only a throughput bound; no finite FIFO, synchronous SRAM latency, last-beat handoff, accumulator backpressure, or double-buffer swap model proves zero bubbles.
p1.impact: The layout is conflict-free but the inherited 3/4/4/5-cycle PWP service remains an optimistic scheduling assumption.
p1.minimal_fix: Replay all descriptor and bank-request digests in VCS with finite queues, ready/valid assertions, randomized backpressure, and zero-loss/ordering checks.

p1.finding: The strongest +18.75 percent result uses an exact 460-row bank; rounding to 464 or 512 rows lowers the saving to 18.06 or 9.72 percent.
p1.impact: Using +18.75 percent without an available 460-row macro overstates realizable capacity advantage.
p1.minimal_fix: Select actual SRAM compiler macros, include ECC/spares/periphery, and headline the implemented 464/512-equivalent capacity and total area.

p1.finding: M81 changes staging organization but models neither multi-PWP concurrency nor a new cycle path; catalog traffic is identical to M80 and shared32 speedup remains inherited from M78.
p1.impact: The large reversal from M80 -72.61 percent to M81 +18.75 percent is a capacity-feasibility result, not a new acceleration factor.
p1.minimal_fix: Keep capacity and speedup columns separate, compare equal-resource fixed12/elastic RTL, and publish throughput only after VCS and STA closure.

p1.finding: No DC/Formality/STA/SAIF/PTPX, macro energy, accuracy replay, or full-network composition exists for the interleaved buffer.
p1.impact: Area/energy merit and DATE-level system advantage remain unknown even though the packed byte accounting is strong.
p1.minimal_fix: Close VCS and Synopsys on 464/512-row candidates, integrate measured memory/access energy into the full-network simulator, and retain the valid825-internal claim boundary.

score_interpretation: The unified word-interleaved buffer is a meaningful hardware organization improvement and decisively repairs M80's width-class over-allocation. The primary packed layout is mathematically sound, but the aligned branch has a concrete descriptor overflow and neither cross-row/barrel timing nor zero-bubble behavior has reached RTL or Synopsys evidence.

go: GO for WORD_PACKED_8X32_INTERLEAVED RTL using eight independently addressed banks.
GO for changing the common descriptor to a 13-bit start_word using the existing reserved bit.
GO for 464-row and 512-row macro-aware VCS/Synopsys A/B; retain 460 rows only as an exact lower envelope.
no_go: NO-GO for ENTRY_ALIGNED_32B under the current descriptor contract.
NO-GO for zero-bubble, one-cycle cross-row timing, power, energy, or new speedup claims.
NO-GO for +18.75 percent as a physical headline until a matching macro is selected.
NO-GO for DATE/best-paper promotion before VCS, Synopsys, and system closure.

recommended_next_milestone.name: M81B 13-bit descriptor and macro-aware interleaved-bank RTL closure
must_include: 13-bit start_word for both packed and aligned formats
eight independent 32-bit bank address ports with frozen-request assertions
pipelined base/base+1 selectors, barrel reorder, and final-word masks
finite descriptor, payload, correction, and accumulator queues
VCS replay of all 835,382 independent bank-request beats
464-row and 512-row macro mappings with ECC/periphery byte ledger
capacity-versus-fixed12 and inherited-speedup columns kept separate
